create_prometheus_registry: create a Prometheus registry that supports multiprocess mode via PROMETHEUS_MULTIPROC_DIR environment variable
get_prometheus_metrics: get the latest Prometheus metrics content as a UTF-8 decoded string from the collector registry
update_queue_jobs_total: update the queue_jobs_total gauge metric from JobTotalMetricDocument database records
profile_method_steps: profile method step processing times using StepProfiler context manager with Prometheus histogram
monitor_parquet_disk_usage: monitor parquet metadata disk usage by updating the PARQUET_METADATA_DISK_USAGE gauge with psutil disk_usage
